warnings.issue: Tab buttons lack ARIA attributes for screen readers
warnings.details: No aria-selected, role='tab', role='tablist', or aria-controls attributes
warnings.impact: Screen reader users cannot properly navigate tabs or understand tab/panel relationships
warnings.recommendation: Add ARIA attributes: role='tablist' on .mc-tab-bar, role='tab' and aria-selected on buttons, aria-controls linking tabs to panels

warnings.details: Left/Right arrow keys, Home/End keys not implemented for tab switching
warnings.impact: Keyboard-only users must tab through all buttons instead of using arrow keys
warnings.recommendation: Implement keyboard handler: Left/Right arrows to switch tabs, Home/End to jump to first/last tab

warnings.issue: No automatic focus management when switching tabs
warnings.details: When switching tabs, focus remains on tab button. First interactive element in panel should receive focus.
warnings.impact: Keyboard users must re-navigate to panel content after switching tabs
warnings.recommendation: Add focus management: when switching tabs, move focus to first focusable element in newly activated panel (e.g., textarea, input, button)
